name: Bourbon House e Youkoso
original_name: バーボンハウスへようこそ
source:
All kind of customers visit the Bourbon House. Some enjoy drinking alone, some drink to heal their wounds, some have secrets... that they can't tell others.

Wataru Yamadori, one of its customers, has an usual hobby. He likes to buy drinks for other customers and listen to their story. 

Like always, he sits at the corner of the counter. There are as many stories as there are people in the Bourbon house. Who will he talk to tonight?
translation:
各种各样的客人都会来到波本屋。有的喜欢独酌，有的借酒疗伤，还有的藏着无法对人说出的秘密……

常客之一山鸟涉，有个特别的爱好。他喜欢请其他客人喝酒，听他们讲述各自的故事。

今天，他也像往常一样，坐在吧台角落。波本屋里有多少人，就有多少故事。今晚，他又会与谁交谈呢？
